introduction: This spec lets a program that embeds `gatewayd.Server` (module `sandbox/gatewayd`) own the gateway's authentication. The embedder passes an `Authenticator` callback that turns a bearer token into a principal. The server keys sandbox ownership by that principal, exposes it to the backend through `PrincipalFromContext`, and gives the embedder `(*Server).Destroy` to end any held sandbox. The static token-list mode, the `agentkit-gateway` command, clients and both wire protocols keep their spec 19 behaviour.

glossary.Authenticator: The embedder-supplied func(ctx context.Context, token string) (principal string, ok bool) that callback mode calls once per RPC from the tap handle.
glossary.callback mode: A gatewayd.Server built with a non-nil Config.Authenticate and an empty Config.Tokens. The embedder's callback decides which tokens are accepted.
glossary.held sandbox: A sandbox whose entry is currently in the server's registry: created, recorded by gatewayService.Create, and not yet removed by any path.
glossary.principal: The non-secret owner identity of an authenticated RPC. In callback mode it is the string the Authenticator returns. In static mode it is the 64-character lowercase hex SHA-256 of the token. Sandbox ownership is keyed by it.
glossary.removal path: registry.remove, the single code path that deletes a registry entry once, stops its TTL timer, closes the backend sandbox and logs 'sandbox destroyed' with a reason.
glossary.static mode: A gatewayd.Server built with a non-empty Config.Tokens and a nil Config.Authenticate. This is spec 19's token-list authentication.
glossary.tap handle: The grpc.InTapHandle function (Server.tap). It runs on the connection's I/O goroutine before gRPC reads any request message.

requirements.title: Configuration with exactly one authentication mode
requirements.rationale: An embedder must pick either the static list or the callback, and a configuration with neither or both must fail at construction rather than at the first RPC.

criteria.action: export `type Authenticator func(ctx context.Context, token string) (principal string, ok bool)` and the field `Config.Authenticate Authenticator`

criteria.condition: New is called with a non-empty Config.Tokens and a non-nil Config.Authenticate
criteria.action: refuse the configuration
criteria.contract: returns a nil *Server and a non-nil error whose text contains both 'Tokens' and 'Authenticate' and contains no configured token

criteria.condition: New is called with a nil or empty Config.Tokens and a nil Config.Authenticate
criteria.action: refuse the configuration
criteria.contract: returns a nil *Server and a non-nil error whose text contains both 'Tokens' and 'Authenticate'

criteria.condition: New is called with a non-empty Config.Tokens and a nil Config.Authenticate
criteria.action: validate the tokens with internal/token.Validate as spec 19 does
criteria.contract: an invalid list (too short, non-printable, repeated) returns the spec 19 error 'gatewayd: Config.Tokens: ...' unchanged

criteria.condition: New is called with a non-nil Config.Authenticate and an empty Config.Tokens
criteria.action: apply no token validation, and validate Backend, the limits, TLS and NetworkModes with the spec 19 rules and error texts
criteria.contract: returns a non-nil *Server and a nil error when the other fields are valid; a nil Backend still returns 'gatewayd: Config.Backend is nil'

requirements.title: Static mode authentication and principal
requirements.rationale: Existing deployments must not see a behaviour change, and a backend still needs a stable, non-secret name for each token.

criteria.condition: the server runs in static mode
criteria.action: authenticate each RPC in the tap handle and again in both the unary and stream interceptors, comparing the token's SHA-256 with every configured hash using crypto/subtle.ConstantTimeCompare
criteria.contract: a token absent from Config.Tokens gets codes.Unauthenticated with message 'gatewayd: a valid bearer token is required', as in spec 19

criteria.action: for any token accepted in static mode, use the 64-character lowercase hex encoding of its SHA-256 as the RPC's principal
criteria.contract: PrincipalFromContext on the backend's Create context returns hex.EncodeToString(sha256.Sum256(token)) with ok == true

criteria.condition: the server runs in static mode
criteria.action: log the 'sandbox created' owner attribute as the first 8 hex characters of the principal, and never write the full 64-character principal to any log line
criteria.contract: the owner attribute equals the principal's 8-character prefix; the log output contains no 64-character hex hash of a configured token

requirements.title: Callback mode: when the authenticator runs, and revocation
requirements.rationale: Running the callback once, in the tap, keeps the rule that nothing is read before authentication and gives a single answer per RPC.

criteria.condition: in callback mode an RPC's authorization metadata is missing, repeated, lacks the 'Bearer ' prefix, or carries an empty token
criteria.action: refuse the RPC without calling the authenticator
criteria.contract: codes.Unauthenticated with message 'gatewayd: a valid bearer token is required'; the authenticator's call count is unchanged

criteria.condition: in callback mode an RPC carries exactly one authorization value of the form 'Bearer <non-empty token>'
criteria.action: call the authenticator exactly once for that unary RPC or stream from the tap handle, passing the tap's context (which carries the peer address) and the token byte for byte as presented, with no length or character rule of the server's own
criteria.contract: the authenticator records one call per unary RPC and one per stream; a 1-byte token and a token with characters outside printable ASCII reach the authenticator unchanged

criteria.condition: in callback mode the authenticator returns ok == false
criteria.action: refuse the RPC in the tap handle before gRPC reads any request message, including for a method no handler serves
criteria.contract: codes.Unauthenticated with message 'gatewayd: a valid bearer token is required'; no backend method is called and no handler runs

criteria.condition: in callback mode the authenticator accepts a token with a valid principal
criteria.action: place the principal on the RPC's context, and let the unary and stream interceptors pass the RPC on without calling the authenticator again
criteria.contract: the handler and the backend see the principal through PrincipalFromContext; the authenticator's call count for the RPC stays at 1

criteria.condition: in callback mode a unary or stream interceptor receives a context that carries no principal
criteria.action: refuse the RPC without calling the handler
criteria.contract: codes.Unauthenticated with message 'gatewayd: a valid bearer token is required'

criteria.condition: the authenticator stops accepting a token it previously accepted
criteria.action: refuse every later RPC that presents that token, let RPCs already in flight under it run to their end, and keep the principal's sandboxes registered until TTL expiry, a client Destroy under the same principal, (*Server).Destroy, or Shutdown
criteria.contract: later RPCs get codes.Unauthenticated; an execute already in flight returns its normal result; the sandbox stays visible to another token that maps to the same principal

requirements.title: Callback mode: invalid principals and panics
requirements.rationale: An embedder bug must not create an unowned sandbox, flood the logs, or bring down the process.

criteria.condition: the authenticator returns ok == true with an empty principal
criteria.action: treat the result as ok == false and refuse the RPC
criteria.contract: codes.Unauthenticated; no sandbox is created

criteria.condition: the authenticator returns ok == true with a principal longer than 256 bytes
criteria.action: treat the result as ok == false and refuse the RPC
criteria.contract: a 257-byte principal gets codes.Unauthenticated; a 256-byte principal is accepted

criteria.condition: the authenticator panics
criteria.action: recover the panic, refuse the RPC, and keep serving other RPCs on the same and other connections
criteria.contract: the RPC gets codes.Unauthenticated; the process does not exit; a following RPC on the same connection whose token the authenticator accepts succeeds

criteria.action: for any principal of 1 to 256 bytes, including non-ASCII and control bytes, accept it unchanged and compare it with other principals byte for byte
criteria.contract: PrincipalFromContext returns the exact bytes the authenticator returned

requirements.title: Ownership by principal
requirements.rationale: Several tokens of one tenant must share sandboxes, and a foreign tenant must not be able to tell that a sandbox exists.

criteria.action: in both modes, record each sandbox under the principal of the Create RPC that made it, and filter lookup, access, list, relay routing, SyncGit and the Destroy RPC by that principal string

criteria.condition: an RPC whose token maps to principal P addresses a sandbox created under P, including through a different token from the one that created it
criteria.action: serve the RPC against that sandbox
criteria.contract: List includes the id; the Agent relay reaches the sandbox; SyncGit syncs it; the Destroy RPC removes it with reason 'client'

criteria.condition: an RPC whose token maps to principal Q addresses a sandbox created under a different principal P
criteria.action: answer exactly as spec 19 answers for an id that does not exist, and leave the sandbox untouched
criteria.contract: List omits the id; the Destroy RPC answers OK and the sandbox stays registered; the Agent relay and SyncGit answer codes.Unavailable with a message naming the id

requirements.title: Logs
requirements.rationale: Operators need to know why an RPC was refused without the logs ever exposing a secret.

criteria.condition: a sandbox is created in callback mode
criteria.action: log 'sandbox created' with the owner attribute set to the full principal as the authenticator returned it
criteria.contract: the JSON log record's owner field equals the principal

criteria.condition: the server refuses an RPC's authentication in either mode
criteria.action: log the Warn message 'authentication refused' with the peer attribute and a reason attribute
criteria.contract: the message text and the peer attribute are unchanged from spec 19; reason is one of 'no token', 'refused', 'invalid principal', 'panic'

criteria.condition: the refusal is due to a missing, repeated, non-Bearer or empty authorization header
criteria.action: set the refusal's reason to 'no token'
criteria.contract: reason == "no token"

criteria.condition: the refusal is due to no static hash matching, the authenticator returning ok == false, or an interceptor finding no principal
criteria.action: set the refusal's reason to 'refused'
criteria.contract: reason == "refused"

criteria.condition: the refusal is due to an empty principal or one longer than 256 bytes
criteria.action: set the refusal's reason to 'invalid principal'
criteria.contract: reason == "invalid principal"

criteria.condition: the refusal is due to a recovered authenticator panic
criteria.action: set the refusal's reason to 'panic' and leave the panic value out of every log line
criteria.contract: reason == "panic"; the log output does not contain the panic value

criteria.action: in both modes, keep every log line free of any token, any authenticator panic value, any full static-mode hash, any Spec.Env value and any tool payload, including a planted token that the authenticator receives and accepts
criteria.contract: the captured log output contains none of the planted strings

requirements.title: The principal on the backend's context
requirements.rationale: An embedder's backend has to know at Create, Sync and Reap which tenant is calling, and it must not be able to forge a principal.

criteria.action: export `func PrincipalFromContext(ctx context.Context) (principal string, ok bool)`, which reads an unexported context key, and export no function or key that puts a principal on a context

criteria.condition: the server calls Backend.Create while serving a Gateway.Create RPC
criteria.action: pass a context that carries the RPC's principal
criteria.contract: PrincipalFromContext returns the creating RPC's principal and ok == true

criteria.condition: the server calls a backend sandbox's Sync while serving a SyncGit RPC
criteria.action: pass a context that carries the RPC's principal
criteria.contract: PrincipalFromContext returns the SyncGit RPC's principal and ok == true

criteria.condition: the server calls Backend.Reap while serving a Gateway.Reap RPC
criteria.action: pass a context that carries the RPC's principal
criteria.contract: PrincipalFromContext returns the Reap RPC's principal and ok == true

criteria.condition: the server runs its periodic reap at Serve start or after each ReapInterval
criteria.action: call Backend.Reap with a context that carries no principal
criteria.contract: PrincipalFromContext returns ("", false)

criteria.condition: the server closes a backend sandbox on its own, for a client Destroy, TTL expiry, unavailability, Shutdown or a Create error path
criteria.action: call the sandbox's Close with a context that carries no principal
criteria.contract: PrincipalFromContext returns ("", false) on every such Close context

criteria.condition: PrincipalFromContext receives a context the server did not make, such as context.Background() or a context with a string-keyed value 'principal'
criteria.action: report no principal
criteria.contract: returns ("", false)

requirements.title: Destroy from the embedder
requirements.rationale: An embedder has to end a tenant's sandbox from its own side, for example when a lease ends, without holding a client token.

criteria.condition: the embedder calls (*Server).Destroy(ctx, id) for a held sandbox, whatever its principal
criteria.action: remove the entry through the registry's single removal path with reason 'embedder', stop its TTL timer, call the backend sandbox's Close with ctx (which ends the relayed calls in flight), and log 'sandbox destroyed' with reason 'embedder'
criteria.contract: returns nil when Close returns nil; the backend's Close count rises by 1 and its context is the caller's ctx

criteria.condition: the backend sandbox's Close fails or ctx is cancelled during (*Server).Destroy
criteria.action: leave the entry removed and return the Close error wrapped with the id
criteria.contract: the returned error names the id, and errors.Is and errors.As reach the backend's error; a later Destroy for that id returns ErrNotHeld

criteria.condition: (*Server).Destroy is called for an id the server does not hold: unknown, already removed by any path including a previous Destroy, before Serve, or after Shutdown
criteria.action: return without calling any backend method
criteria.contract: returns an error that names the id and satisfies errors.Is(err, gatewayd.ErrNotHeld), where ErrNotHeld = errors.New("gatewayd: sandbox not held")

criteria.condition: (*Server).Destroy is called for an id whose backend Create has returned but which gatewayService.Create has not yet recorded
criteria.action: treat the id as not held
criteria.contract: returns an error matching ErrNotHeld

criteria.condition: (*Server).Destroy has found a held entry
criteria.guard: a concurrent removal of the same entry (client Destroy, expiry, unavailability or Shutdown) deletes it first
criteria.action: skip the Close and the destroy log of its own
criteria.contract: returns nil; the backend sandbox's Close is called exactly once in total

criteria.condition: (*Server).Destroy has removed a client's sandbox
criteria.action: answer that client as it answers after TTL expiry
criteria.contract: the next proxy tool call returns the sandbox_unavailable error; List omits the id; the client Destroy RPC answers OK; SyncGit answers codes.Unavailable naming the id

criteria.action: close backend sandboxes with context.Background() for every removal reason other than 'embedder' (client, expired, unavailable, shutdown)

requirements.title: Compatibility, test harness and exported surface
requirements.rationale: Existing deployments, the command and spec 19's tests must not move, and the harness must reach callback mode without a new builder.

criteria.action: fill Config.Tokens from --token-file, never set Config.Authenticate, and keep every flag and exit code unchanged
criteria.contract: an authentication refusal logs 'authentication refused' with peer and a reason of 'no token' or 'refused'

criteria.condition: the server runs in static mode
criteria.action: keep spec 19's refusals, status codes, error texts and log messages, adding only the reason attribute on 'authentication refused'
criteria.contract: every existing spec 19 test in sandbox/gatewayd and its command passes without modification

criteria.condition: gwtest.Start receives a Config
criteria.action: set Tokens to [Token, TokenB] only when both Tokens and Authenticate are unset
criteria.contract: a Config with Authenticate set starts a callback-mode server with Tokens left empty

criteria.action: record the (principal, ok) result of PrincipalFromContext for every Create, Reap and sandbox Sync it serves, readable through accessors

add exactly five exported identifiers relative to spec 19 (Authenticator, Config.Authenticate, PrincipalFromContext, (*Server).Destroy and ErrNotHeld), and change neither gateway.proto, sandbox.proto, the sandbox/gateway client package nor sandbox.ProtocolMinor (2)
criteria.contract: an unchanged sandbox/gateway Provider works against servers in both modes

execution_paths.title: An embedder authenticates a lease token and its backend sees the principal at Create

steps.action: calls gatewayd.New(Config{Backend: counting, Authenticate: fn}) and Serve on an in-memory listener
dials with sandbox/gateway and calls Create with a lease token
reads the Bearer header, calls fn once, and places the returned principal on the RPC context
reads PrincipalFromContext in Create, gets the principal, and creates a local sandbox
records the sandbox under the principal and logs 'sandbox created' with owner equal to the principal
runs a tool through the relay and receives its result

execution_paths.title: The embedder ends a leased sandbox and the client sees it gone

steps.action: creates a sandbox in callback mode and starts a tool call
calls (*Server).Destroy(ctx, id)
removes the entry, stops its timer, calls the backend sandbox's Close with ctx, and logs 'sandbox destroyed' with reason 'embedder'
gets sandbox_unavailable on its next proxy call and finds the id absent from List
calls Destroy again for the same id and gets an error matching ErrNotHeld

execution_paths.title: Two tokens of one principal share a sandbox until one is revoked

steps.action: creates a sandbox with token A, which the authenticator maps to principal P
lists sandboxes with token B, also mapped to P, and sees A's sandbox
with a token mapped to principal Q, lists without seeing it and gets Unavailable naming the id from SyncGit
makes the authenticator stop accepting token A
refuses the next RPC with token A with Unauthenticated and logs reason 'refused'
still reaches the sandbox with token B

execution_paths.title: A static-mode server exposes the token hash as the principal

steps.action: builds a server with Config.Tokens through gwtest.Start, as agentkit-gateway does
creates a sandbox with a configured token
authenticates in the tap and both interceptors and passes the hex SHA-256 principal to Backend.Create
records PrincipalFromContext equal to the 64-character lowercase hex SHA-256 of the token
logs 'sandbox created' with the 8-character owner fingerprint and never the full hash
